title: A second migrate on a migrated tree plans to remove an open bug's kept fixture, and a later-day apply deletes it
symptom: On a migrated tree whose open bug names a .chough/artifacts fixture, chough migrate prints a non-empty plan removing that fixture; the same day the apply refuses only because the dated receipt exists; on a later day it applies and deletes the fixture while the bug stays open
trigger: Migrate a 0.5.0 project with an open bug's fixture, commit, then chough migrate again on a later day
expected: A tree with no 0.5.x record has nothing to do, and an open bug's fixture is kept (REQ-records-009)
actual: The kept-fixture rule reads only 0.5.x JSON bugs, so the migrated Markdown bug's fixture reads as an orphan artifact
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester clone at 0ee26ac0, debug build, SpecSync 6.2.0
impact: A routine second migrate deletes an open bug's reproduction fixture
source: t384, test stage, area upgrade (full pass)

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at 748bca6d (leif/0.6.0-test1-red: d854ce1a plus the regression tests): the second plan carried the fixture as a source; fix in 9fd9e701.
